# Srivari Milk Farms

> Srivari Milk Farms is a dairy farm based in D.Hirehal, Anantapur District, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Business Hours

All seven days of the week, Monday through Sunday:
- Morning: 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM
- Evening: 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM
- Time zone: India Standard Time (IST, UTC+05:30)

## Dairy Products

Srivari Milk Farms offers the following dairy product categories:

- A2 desi cow milk
- Buffalo milk
- Traditional Vedic Bilona ghee
- Fresh paneer
- Curd

The A2 description applies to the desi cow milk offering. It should not be applied to buffalo milk.
